reconstruction_summary: Reconstructed agent's V5 (final) model: per-platform joint LS fit of (k_sr, d0, K_us) for the steady-state bicycle psi_dot = v/(L+K_us*v^2)*k_sr*(delta-d0) plus integer-sample lag alignment, refitted on agent's out/all_ford.parquet (with their |a_lat|<20 cleanup) since coefficients were not persisted.
notes: Per-platform fits (refit on agent's parquet): F-150 k_sr=0.9530, d0=0.00114, K_us=0.00331, lag=1; MachE k_sr=1.1778, d0=0.00013, K_us=0.00260, lag=1. Agent's lag-alignment drops |lag| samples per segment so agent_rmse is computed over 1364476 aligned samples vs 1364925 unshifted canonical samples. Baseline recomputed matches canonical V0 to ~1e-12.
